title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-yotd: TH_3 uses ciphertext not plaintext and credential ID not full credential
description:
## Spec deviation: TH_3 composition

**File:** python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py  
**Lines:** 379 (initiator), 608 (responder)

**What the code does:**
```python
th_3_input = cbor2.dumps(self._th_2) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_2) + cbor2.dumps(id_cred_r)
```
Uses CIPHERTEXT_2 and ID_CRED_R (credential identifier), not PLAINTEXT_2 and CRED_R.

**What RFC 9528 §5.4.2 requires:**
> Compute the transcript hash TH_3 = H(TH_2, PLAINTEXT_2, CRED_R),
> where H() is the EDHOC hash algorithm... The input to the hash
> function is a CBOR Sequence.

Uses PLAINTEXT_2 (plaintext before encryption) and CRED_R (the full credential, not just its identifier).

This is a correctness/interop bug that would produce a different TH_3 value.

**Severity:** P1 - correctness/spec-compliance
